headlines.text: Rewind to 2021, when there was a changing of the guard for the IWGP United States Title as Lance Archer vs. Jon Moxley battled it out in a Texas Death Match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.94 ? a good, competitive contest ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. A brutal Texas Death Match rated near four-and-a-half stars by fans ? Archer's hometown crowd roared him on through forks, barbed wire boards, and a fan getting thrown into the ring, and Moxley showed real respect afterward, handing Archer the title himself.
That Friday in 2023, it was a welcome sight as Marina Shafir returned to the ring after just under 2 months away, appearing on Rampage.
On a Friday in 2023, back when Aaron Solow stepped back through the curtain after just under 3 months away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2021, Shawn Spears returned to the fold after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.

2023 brought us this moment: Darby Allin vs. Angelo Parker vs. Big Bill vs. Bishop Kaun vs. Brian Cage vs. Ethan Page vs. Isiah Kassidy vs. Jake Hager vs. Jay Lethal vs. Jeff Jarrett vs. Komander vs. Matt Hardy vs. Matt Menard vs. Matt Sydal vs. Minoru Suzuki vs. Nick Wayne vs. Swerve Strickland vs. The Butcher vs. The Blade vs. Toa Liona fought it out in a Royal Rampage match, opening the card on Rampage, rated 6.51, part of the special Royal Rampage '23 card.
Looking back to 2021, when it was the first-ever encounter between Orange Cassidy and The Blade on Dynamite, rated 5.62.
